sources.native_filename: Konosuba - Spin-off - Consulting the Masked Devil.epub

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: An unnamed guild worker reports a suspected general nearby and suggests its influence may explain weak monsters hiding and fewer suitable jobs; capital knights are a future report. Megumin assumes an apparently abandoned castle can be attacked without complaint. Daily Explosions and Kazuma participation are narrated for a week; he observes the castle still apparently intact.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Do not invent deliberate economic sabotage,an official quest ban,actual capital deployment,proved legal ownership or measured physical castle damage. Megumin bait-plan claim comes later.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: A head-carrying armored Dullahan introduces himself as a recently arrived general and demands the daily blasts stop. He claims an investigation and says he had left the low-level town alone. Megumin briefly diverts attention to a nearby mage,who denies being able to cast Explosion. Her declared lure plan is contradicted by the received earlier routine and Kazuma aside.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: The personal name Beldia has not yet appeared in these received windows; maintain target identity/continuity join pending next context. Generic Dullahan role hits elsewhere are not this individual. Claimed mission/restraint are attributed,not complete ethical history.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: He rejects the alleged daily-Explosion biology,claims former knighthood/no taste for hunting weak people,then deliberately casts a death curse toward Megumin before Aqua chant. Darkness shields her and receives a dark glow. He admits the target changed and reframes a companion suffering as stronger leverage.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Class recognition of ArchPriest is not a class-identification failure. His protection/power appraisal is a self-claim; curse removal later does not by itself test anti-purification defenses. One-week death is a threat/prediction,not a watched death.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Darkness supplies the sexualized captivity interpretation; the Dullahan replies with confusion and appears relieved when Kazuma restrains her from following. He subsequently makes an actual conditional cure offer requiring Megumin to reach his castle room through reported undead knights,and leaves on a headless horse.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: No completed captivity or sexual demand is shown in these paragraphs. The actual curse/terror and risky cure condition remain coercive. Darkness fantasy and the narrator sympathy do not erase that harm; later contrary behavior must not be retroactively inserted as this scene intent.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Megumin takes responsibility and proposes attacking him; Kazuma offers to accompany her and proposes stealth or repeated daily attacks. These plans are interrupted by Aqua actual SacredBreakSpell cast,glow and her claim of an easy curse removal.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: No castle assault or repeated tactical success was performed here. The external cure defeats the intended leverage in this case; precise power thresholds/private motive remain open. Later quiet week is consistent with removal,not an observed untreated curse death test.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Later job selection supplies context for resource differences. Aqua reports a croquette-shop manager anger over leftovers,selects a dangerous high-pay notice and then a water-purification notice. Kazuma objects to the first and considers the second.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Manager conduct,territorial monsters and notice conditions are reports; no new named employer identity,performed monster fight or completed lake purification here. These later paragraphs are not additional Beldia actions.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Continuous returning Dullahan identifies himself as Beldia at P67,joining the C3 encounter. He reports unjust execution/former knighthood,condemns abandoning a protective companion,and is surprised by living Darkness. Megumin continued castle blasts after the warning,with Aqua as carrier. He threatens the whole town and explicitly orders a massacre.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Former life and unjust execution are his account,not an independently received past scene. Continued harassment and his actual disproportionate coercion both remain. Aqua blame for her employment problems is not proof of deliberate economic sabotage.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: TurnUndead and SacredTurnUndead cause smoke,cries and staggering,but Beldia persists. He asks about Aqua level/novice status after the effect and invokes armored blessing/power. Undead knights enter town but chase Aqua despite his orders to attack others.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Resistance is partial,not invulnerability or failed casting. Kazuma explanation of subordinates attraction and his claim Beldia is afraid are conjectures; Beldia offers tradition as rival reason for deploying subordinates. Unnamed army diviner is not automatically Soketto.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Kazuma gathers the undead around Aqua; Megumin destroys the entire gathered group with Explosion outside the gate. Beldia laughs,acknowledges unexpected defeat of his troops and attacks personally. His thrown head affords an elevated view and frees both hands; he avoids attackers and actually kills the charging adventurers.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: His willingness to fight here is contrary to an absolute avoidance rule. Later resurrection does not make the killings imaginary. The exact mechanics and global limits of head vision remain local inference plus observed evasion.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Beldia first evades Darkness,then dismisses her missed strike. His blow only scratches her armor; he asks about her defense and attacks with greater force. He curses supporting casters and briefly interrupts them,then they resume. Repeated strikes injure Darkness. He expresses confusion at her sexualized interpretation. Water makes him jump away.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Do not credit a completed curse on Kazuma when he points at him,or an untreated curse death. Darkness supplies the stripping interpretation; no intentional sexual stripping plan is established by her fantasy. Surprise at her defense is distinct from inability to update.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Kazuma Freeze/Steal fails; Beldia explains level disparity and avoids Darkness even on ice. Repeated ordinary water interrupts attacks but he evades it. When Aqua prepares a much larger spell he turns to flee,blocked by Darkness.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: A failed attempt and own explanation do not establish universal immunity. His threat assessment and flight contradict an absolute stand-and-fight code. Kazuma vampire analogy motivates an experiment; it is not universal Dullahan biology.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Aqua flood weakens Beldia and sweeps up allies and caster too. Kazuma full-mana Steal takes the head rather than sword; Beldia politely asks its return. Adventurers kick the head around while his body cannot see. Darkness strikes the disabled body,breaks blessed armor,and Aqua subsequent SacredTurnUndead makes the body and head disappear.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Water,armor damage,capture and a changed-mana Steal are sequential interacting conditions,not isolated causal trials. Do not erase the head-kicking harm as nonliteral comedy or infer a durable polite disposition from dependence. No later retelling automatically constitutes resurrection.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Darkness prays for the defeated enemy and describes the slain Sedol,Hains and Garil. Three men return with apologies; Aqua says she resurrected them. The next day the receptionist announces a 300-million-Eris party award and presents a 340-million partial damage charge for Aqua flood.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: The three-name set needs mapping checks before assigning each anonymous apologetic speaker. Reported earlier teasing is not a watched earlier scene. Drinking together/offering to buy drinks is not shown completed. Award,charge and settlement remain distinct; flood success is not safety.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Dust party visits the abandoned castle. Claire repeats a deliberate-lure version of the old battle; Dust qualifies it. Burned/collapsed exterior,comparatively clean interior and bucket/rag are observed. Dust attributes damage to repeated Explosions and conjectures former knight cleanliness.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Retelling is not a second performance or proof of a successful prior plan. Dust safety/ownership statements remain reports. Observed later damage does not erase MAIN01 Kazuma earlier impression of an intact castle; different times and perspectives are retained.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Dust opens Yunyun bag despite her objection; Claire/Rain power a crystal said to share embarrassing pasts. It also projects a Dullahan scene. Rain conjectures residual thoughts in the rag explain this. The projection depicts Beldia cleaning,checking dust,recruiting knights to help,repairing repeated damage,initially forgiving novices,then angrily departing. After the curse encounter it shows him preparing balanced forces/traps at moderate difficulty so he can personally finish the intruders; another blast breaks preparations.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: This is a current received fictional magical projection of an earlier event,not a live resurrection,a new independent battle or the reader own firsthand past observation. The rag mechanism is Rain hypothesis. Humming/cleanliness give bounded positive activity,not an exhaustive hobby/personality diagnosis. Moderate difficulty is controlled coercion,not proof of safety or fulfilled cure conditions.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Leen uses a clue from the projection to locate a hidden passage. Party expectations include treasure/intelligence; they actually find Vanir using the room for food storage.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Yunyun imagined hidden human friend and Dust imagined kidnapping are speculation,not a Beldia captive. The hidden room contents are not automatically Beldia assets or traps,and Vanir current use is distinct from Beldia earlier activity.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Vanir retrospectively narrates Wiz report: her party wounded a general but all received a month death curse; the highest-level capital ArchPriest reportedly could not remove it,and the issuer fled to the Demon King castle. She offers her remaining soul to save companions; Vanir rejects that price and teaches a forbidden method with a conditional future exchange.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Earlier battle and priest failure are nested reports. The month period is preserved alongside MAIN01 week threats; do not silently standardize timers or infer all priests always fail. Original soul-price contract is not accepted/completed.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: During a castle intrusion an ogre reports Hans frozen and unable to fight,and Sylvia defeated by touch/drain. Vanir identifies the injured Beldia location. Beldia speech heard from his room acknowledges the companion curse,offers to lift it and praises the intruder courage while asking for a draw. A blast/cry and soldiers defeat report follow; Wiz emerges and identifies as a novice lich.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Hans is reported incapacitated,not killed. No direct view of Beldia earlier recovery or exact final spell is supplied. Offer is face-saving bargaining under threat,not proof of performed cure or his final death here. This earlier account is distinct from MAIN01 later purification. Wiz restored resource explanation is Vanir inference,not literally inexhaustible mana.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Kazuma hears Hans describe completed sabotage and a long time horizon. Wolbach directly says she is there for recuperation and repeatedly does not want involvement; Hans proposes continued reports anyway. After Kazuma enters,Hans reads his gaze as curiosity rather than suspicion,leaves for work,and is observed dry.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: The lengthy preparation and completed sabotage are his account here. His inference that Kazuma did not hear is wrong; the desire he notices is real but not exhaustive. Wolbach noninvolvement request is not an agreement to help. Dry skin is a clue,not a watched failed bath or proof of inability to bathe.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Party investigates source poisoning. Two Eris-faith guards deny access even after Aqua claims her class,then accept the Dustiness pendant obtained over Darkness resistance. They report an elderly blond manager went ahead. Dissolved monster remains are found,with no watched killer.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Access denial is not a failed spell. Kazuma broad claim an old man could not be strong receives Aqua contrary examples; all remain attributed. Guards report of the manager is not directly observed transformation or consumption. Do not silently join these two to earlier other guards.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Aqua identifies black poisoned sources,actually purifies them while heat burns her; Wiz cooling succeeds where Kazuma weaker Freeze does not. Hans is recognized in the earlier bath appearance,denies wrongdoing and offers a search for poison. Wiz recognition and named species/mimicry remarks break his cover; he attempts an exit,is blocked,reveals himself,and questions a noninterference arrangement.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Heat injury is distinct from poison affliction. Kazuma source-connection experiment explanation and Wiz mimicry interpretation are conjectures until later admissions/observed actions. Years of preparation are Hans report. Wiz greeting is not consent to sabotage,and his account of her arrangement omits the later civilian limit.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Hans shifts vigilance from Wiz to Kazuma after the latter boasts and stands firm. Kazuma game-slime assumption causes real misassessment; actual rank and party warnings make him flee. Hans pursues,then clarifies the weak Adventurer job and dismisses him,returning to his objective.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Hans reads confidence from Kazuma actual ignorance,not successful knowledge of the whole plan. Letting him go is bounded goal prioritization/contempt,not blanket mercy or an incapacity to attack. Party warnings of contact death/failed resurrection are not a watched Kazuma consumption or death in this book.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Hans is directly seen contaminating a source with his hand. He admits consuming the real manager; Wiz freezes the hand/source and states her civilian-killing exception. Hans asks/threatens her to stop,breaks off the frozen arm,regrows and runs to the last source. When lower-body freezing stops him he throws detached pieces; Kazuma intercepts them with Sniper and Aqua Blessing.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: The manager death is an admission accepted in dialogue,not an independently watched past killing. Mimicry consumption condition is interrupted dialogue completed by narrator,not a demonstrated universal biological test. Hans freezing and escape establish resistance with counters,not universal magic immunity. His chosen avoidance of Wiz is distinct from an inability to fight.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: An additional thrown piece reaches the last source when Kazuma runs out of arrows; Hans also reacts in surprise. Aqua persists in purification,Wiz cuts contaminated pipe. Hans enlarges,absorbs vegetation/soil and moves toward the source. Food thrown by Kazuma redirects him temporarily. Explosion fragments him; Darkness shields allies and Wiz drains Kazuma as he loses consciousness.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Do not credit Hans with foresight of the arrow budget. Instinct/reduced reason and food macronutrient explanation are Kazuma hypotheses; observed food diversion is bounded evidence. Wiz inadequate mana depends on enlarged volume. Darkness objects to use of gifts; later replacement does not create prior consent.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Kazuma retrospectively reports all fragments frozen and Aqua full purification after his loss of consciousness. Purification removes ordinary spring qualities and nearly purifies Wiz; the party uses Darkness life force to restore her. Bounty is applied to damages. Zesta epilogue reports a new potent holy-water resource and proposed higher profits plus indirect reimbursement plan.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Post-blackout events are explicit later narration/report,not Kazuma direct observation at the time. No viewer may infer a completed reimbursement or successful future holy-water business from a proposal. Kazuma temporary economic-collapse judgment differs from later reader knowledge. Nearly purified Wiz is not a death. No new independent validation from the same event retelling.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Serena introduces herself and asks to join Kazuma party,then offers personal service,recognition and chosen-hero praise despite Aqua opposition. Kazuma refuses current recruitment; she leaves while saying she could help. Next day she provides free support spells in the guild and rebuts Aqua objections using public-service and reputation arguments.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Refusal is actual,not a completed recruitment. Her favorable statement about Aqua power qualifies a blanket underestimation claim. Early reader/character knowledge has not yet received her later admission of deception; do not retroactively write the hidden mechanism as an already stated fact at this point.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Dust initially voices distrust and favors Aqua,then switches public praise after Serena forgoes her share of the reward. Unusually red-eyed undead do not approach Aqua until attacked; her actual completed TurnUndead leaves them active. Serena speaks TurnUndead and they collapse. Recruiters surround her but she insists on Kazuma party.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: This is an actual failed Aqua cast,not access denial or unavailability. The later explanation of puppet mechanisms remains pending in this current pass. Spoken cast and observed collapse are received,but do not infer a universal comparative purification ranking. The reward shift is narrated evidence,not an independent validation trial of an earlier Dust model.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Serena heals adventurers and builds a queue. Aqua demands priority for a deliberately caused small wound; Serena upholds queue fairness. Serena repeatedly casts Heal but Aqua wound stays; Kazuma attributes it to Aqua deliberate resistance. Aqua later self-heals. Amid her disturbance Serena again invites Kazuma to speak privately elsewhere.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: A failed treatment in a resisting recipient does not establish general poor healing ability or deliberate Serena refusal. Aqua severe-wound/death claims are a performed grievance,not actual lethal injury. The queue rule is locally reasonable even while later strategic aims remain to be checked.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Serena chooses a quiet alley where conversation can be changed if interrupted. She tells a cursed-maiden Demon King story,requests delay or access to Kazuma party,and links him to a legendary Satou swordsman. Kazuma is excited but denies power/intent to kill. Wiz recognizes her as Celesdina and describes a human DarkPriest infiltrator. Serena denies,uses Heal to hurt lich Wiz,then explicitly admits she is executive Celesdina while adding a sister-rescue justification.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: The alias join is secured by her own P83 admission,not solely resemblance or Wiz recognition. Do not merge Serena/Seresdina with Sena. Maiden/sister story is still her account here,not an actual maiden body or reliable Demon King history. Satou lineage claim is rejected by Kazuma; no verified kinship or new legendary-agent census admission is earned.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Vanir interrupts; Serena feigns first acquaintance and tries to depart. A bug-killing item interests her,she attempts to return it after safety concerns,and Vanir threatens to expose her identity if she ceases being a customer. She accepts a price of 1200800Eris against a stated 400000base,angrily throws her wallet,which Vanir catches,and laments loss of all money. Her speech shifts from formal deferential to rough self-reference and invective.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Transaction is coerced,not free generosity or proof she wanted a dangerous item after learning concerns. Amount/all-money status is dialogue,not a separately counted cash inventory. No actual item use,physical effect or death occurs here. Threatened crowd beating is not completed. Printed register shift is textual voice evidence,not assistant-heard acoustics.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Serena identifies as Celesdina,in charge of scheming/intelligence,and a DarkPriest of Regina. She asks for tobacco after abstaining while maintaining her public persona. She explicitly admits the grave corpses were her puppets,not undead,and describes their laborious preparation. She also admits the cursed-maiden tale is a device for neutralizing capable adventurers by offering an excuse to wait.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: These are later explicit admissions after MAIN14 early scenes,not prior reader knowledge. A false target category explains the particular purification failure without erasing Aqua completed failed cast. Claimed reuse of the scheme in other towns is her report,not separately watched events. Concealed smoking is not evidence of inability to refrain.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Serena says the Demon King ordered this investigation,describes his concern about Kazuma,and offers recruitment. Kazuma refuses to oppose people who helped him. She offers to report him harmless and keep subordinates away in exchange for secrecy/noninterference and no appeal to Wiz/Vanir. He accepts,then actually lends money at her request. He later suppresses party investigation despite their reported name/card anomalies.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Demon King belief,future report and subordinate arrangement remain attributed/pending. Recruitment refusal is actual. Loan is an actual transfer with unspecified amount; later repayment is not yet received. Sexual incentives are a proposed recruitment lure,not completed relations or consent. Kazuma self-protective pact does not bind uninformed companions.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Serena publicly offers Regina blessings and love charms; she declines a lonely CrimsonDemon request for friends. Privately she warns that killing her would curse the killer and a large part of town. At her invitation Kazuma pricks her with a toothpick and gets a matching small bleeding wound.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Promised love charms and outcomes are not performed here. Small reflected injury is observed; mass death/half-town curse remains a threat,prediction and unperformed condition. Do not inflate a local demonstration into a measured universal scope. Do not count hurt-to-test invitation as consent to later unrequested attacks.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: A wounded adventurer asks for Aqua but followers block her. Serena repeated Heal closes most wounds; the recipient then insists on Serena and rejects Aqua further help. Kazuma suspects puppet control. Serena privately threatens consequences for breaking secrecy,then acknowledges her loan debt by allowing Kazuma alone to interfere without holding the town hostage,provided he tells nobody or calls Wiz/Vanir.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Serena healing is real but incomplete; Aqua is blocked/rejected rather than casting and failing here. Gratitude/control causation remains Kazuma suspicion at this point. Her concession asserts the debt cleared,not actual return of the borrowed cash. She interprets him as practical/cowardly; the following attack is contrary to a universal no-interference prediction.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Companions support Kazuma while lacking his secret information. Aqua asks whether the town needs her; he requests buffs and later treatment/conveyance/crowd management,then actually dropkicks the departing Serena after announcing he will interfere. She turns in surprise.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Assault is actual and contrary to Serena expectation; reflected full result continues into the next chapter and is not yet certified in this receipt. Kazuma solo challenge still includes actual prior buffs and planned aftercare. The toothpick demonstration invitation does not authorize a dropkick.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Kazuma reports reflected kick pain and loss of consciousness; now unhurt,he assumes Aqua healed him. A brown-haired woman knight conducting his detention infers he knows more from changing excuses,his prior contributions and the town changes. She physically grabs him and proposes a lie-detecting device. Darkness asks release; she notes no victim complaint and gives the key. She admires Darkness perceived independence and reacts to Kazuma disclosures.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Recovery attribution is Kazuma inference,not a watched healing cast. Lie detector use is proposed,not performed. Kazuma threatens fabricated harassment accusations; do not turn them into actual officer conduct. Her legal explanations are in-world statements,not general real-world law or proof of a full court process. Later name/age must not be backfilled into earlier character knowledge.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Serena resumes public counseling despite the attack. She gives a rejected suitor general reassurance; Kazuma twists it into alleged romantic interest,ignores her refusal and encourages the man to press her. She objects and tries to preserve her persona.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Serena kind words are not romantic consent or an obligation to date. The hopeful man is unnamed and is not automatically any earlier adventurer. A locally comforting response can be real even with a larger manipulative agenda; no completed relationship is shown.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Kazuma shoots a cup; hot coffee burns Serena and his hand too. Followers provide a windowless shelter; he and Yunyun prepare invisibility-assisted freezing of its door,leaving her trapped with urgent bodily needs while supporters try to free her. Repeated false rumors and further prepared harassment draw an angry confrontation; she threatens puppet violence and begins a spell posture.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Yunyun invisibility is actually described; Silent is only requested in the received text,not certified performed. Explosive-potion use is contemplated,paint balloons prepared,but neither is deployed here. Killed-by-reflection/city curse remains untested. No completed toilet accident or chemical assault is inferred. Gender rumor is Kazuma deliberately false harassment,not an identity fact.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: A passerby makes Serena resume polite conversation and offer a blessing; Kazuma interrupts with WindBreath and Bind,causing actual public exposure and prolonged restraint against her protests. Followers try to shield her; she cannot get free in the scene. She files a complaint. The officer is troubled by sudden followers and probes the secret; she discusses a desired supportive spouse,then reverses demeanor after Claire/Rain guarantee release. At P461 she identifies herself as twenty-three-year-old Aloerina.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: No completed blessing or named failed dispel incantation is shown. Narrator comparison with Aqua dispelling power is inference from the bind outcome. Exposure is unwanted,not permission or harmless gag. Crowd temporary lucidity/full belief are differing states,not a count of independent minds restored. Aloerina is existing census row91; no Sena/Claire join or duplicate new person. Claire/Rain letter and off-scene arrival are reports; actual release/deference are current scene. Her stated age is not a prior-book age assignment.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Serena mobilizes pursuit and uses crowd placement to drive Kazuma/Aqua to an alley; Wiz/Vanir presence produces a temporary truce. She buys Vanir noninterference contract for a stated730330Eris by handing over her wallet. When Kazuma demands his loan back she takes money from a follower and pays him; the follower briefly wakes,then she deliberately creates a new benefit and control returns.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Large-scale town control and exact full-wallet total are attributed,not an independently counted census. Her pursuit is strategically arranged despite anger,not proof of total incompetence. Contract noninterference differs from confidentiality. Loan repayment is now actual at P607; earlier concession alone was not repayment. Her later voluntary exposure to re-establish a debt does not retroactively authorize Kazuma earlier exposure or touch.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Vanir gives Kazuma a control-removal potion,but Aqua knowingly changes the other stock to water for Wiz without knowing its strategic relevance. Serena/Kazuma laugh at Vanir loss; she admits she cannot stop his fight with Aqua. She proposes withdrawal and harmless report,bounty cancellation,and asks gratitude while smoking. Kazuma thanks her and feels thought/movement impairment; she exploits the opening to give further information as a claimed debt.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Aqua act is intentional transformation,not a failed purification attempt or knowledge of the full control plan. Serena departure/report/bounty cancellation are offers,not yet completed. Declared withdrawal is followed by renewed control,so do not certify reconciliation. She actually smokes; regular habit or enjoyment strength remain bounded. Vanir claim the gifted potion will help her is prospective,not proved here.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Serena describes planned teleport assault on the beginner-training city and coordinated fronts led by Demon King daughter,her own former human-adventurer start there,and coercion using gratitude/resentment. Kazuma becomes controlled and refuses Aqua invitation; later he gives her the removal potion. Serena reports reducing other control to strengthen his,checks his anomalous independent behavior,and explains debt repayment/strong faith as counters. She tells him to pay lodging; he refuses to risk repayment and she discovers her empty wallet.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Army deployment and coordinated attack are future plan/report,not already completed. Former history,Regina sealing and power boost are Serena account; Kazuma sole-follower hypothesis is unconfirmed. Exact capacity/person counts are unknown. She explicitly allows painful resistance to unwanted orders,contradicting a simple total-obedience statement. Her belief that everyone worships something meets Kazuma no-religion statement; do not erase the mismatch. Companion/partner language under control is not free affiliation.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Kazuma solicits money from a prior follower,who loses control after giving it. He then subjects Serena to unwanted sexual contact under a claimed repayment logic; she removes his hands and protests. He pays for one room and proposes sharing; she rejects it. He invokes her broad command to abandon restraint as justification. She considers revoking the command but faces his threatened compensatory demands and still hopes to use him.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Record unwanted contact and explicit refusal in a non-graphic critical account. Do not erase actual abuse or infer an additional off-page sexual assault,shared bed,consensual relation,performed massage or command revocation. His claim that control requires her body is coercive self-serving reasoning,not a valid obligation or creator endorsement. Her earlier manipulations do not remove her boundaries.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Kazuma diary frames several days of Serena efforts to monitor him,stop harassment,earn money,and end control. Diary reports include reciprocal injury when she hits him,her account of failed Moguninnin control,and her account of Vanir business threats/cash extraction. She performs indoor piecework; card job would disclose DarkPriest,so she says ordinary commissions/rewards are unavailable. Drawing money from followers reportedly releases their control. She prays to forcibly end Kazuma control,but he resists through devotion to Regina.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Diary entries are narrator-written retrospective accounts with symbolic dates,not a calendar or separately watched scenes. His inserted erotic fiction is fiction within the diary,not actual Serena nudity or consent. Reported demanded acts remain coercive and non-graphic; do not infer additional completed sexual acts. Moguninnin history is her account nested in his diary,not a watched tampering procedure; frozen C25 foundations stay unchanged. Vanir alleged interference is nested report and no full contract text is read here,so do not certify universal contract breach.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Serena tests Kazuma finger with a toothpick and receives a matching wound,recognizes shared Regina faith,and revises her assumption that all locals have prior belief. He says he is from another country with mixed/nonexclusive customs. She reports inability to release or kill him without recoil,tries strangling him,also suffers and stops. She seeks his companions and detects ghost-like presence at his house; at the guild she refuses more lodging/meal obligations.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: This actual reciprocal injury is bounded support; do not conflate puppetry-not-a-curse with revenge effects called curses. Cultural account is Kazuma explanation,not exhaustive ethnography. No exact universal deity allocation or total immunity follows from this test. A briefly glimpsed blond girl and Serena ghost comment do not by themselves certify a new person or automatic alias. She does not lack all work capacity merely because adventurer-card disclosure limits one route.

source_receiving_annotation_history.observation: Serena says she washed dishes because she could not pay the restaurant bill. She orders Kazuma to dig corpses; he resists painfully. She digs one herself,then casts Marionette and the corpse does not move. She links the failure to control capacity committed to him,and her attempt to reduce that allocation is resisted. Delay means the planned outside-town encounter is no longer timely.
source_receiving_annotation_history.limits: Washing dishes is her report; actual digging,failed animation and allocation struggle are received in the current narration. Puppet points is Kazuma invented label,not a measured numeric game stat. Corpse army attack is not performed. One capacity-dependent failure does not establish general inability or laziness. His refusal and withholding information contribute to costs,not just her poor planning.
